issues: Summary and key points match the post: v30 (2027 wave 1) removes the option to expose pages from Microsoft-published apps as OData endpoints, and the workaround is to copy the page into your own extension.
Both quotes appear in the post, apart from apostrophe style, and both are useful.
The post suggests Data Mirroring to Microsoft Fabric mainly for Power BI use. The summary's more general wording about alternatives is acceptable.
Features, systems and versions are supported by the post. No AL objects are named, so the empty objects list is correct.
